# Introduction

Crows are passive creatures found in Black Forests. They are small birds with long legs and heavy, straight bills. These birds are entirely black, including their legs and feet.

### Drops

• Item: Feathers | 0 Star: 3

## Notes

• Loose-rolling tree logs will roll right through them without damaging them whatsoever.
